Some of the catalog is facility-scale hardware that never sits on a character sheet, so this module describes it rather than shipping items (CSH p.24–33, 74–93):

  • Closed-circuit simsense (CCSS): a security control rig turns the site's alarms, maglocks, cameras, detectors, gun emplacements and drones into the security rigger's "body"; simlinks let secondary riggers ride along. Its weak points are its sensors, its cables and the one person running it.
  • The integrated control center, fiber-optic observation network, decryption and emulation modules: the systems a rigger or magician works through; their game effects are in the Rigger combat and Fiber-optic spellcasting pages.
  • Ares Sentinel drone storage system (p.93): 100,000¥ for 3 Sentinel P, 2 Guardian and 10 weapons pods, with one automated rearming system (one pod change per Combat Turn); additional storage +5,000¥ per Sentinel P, +7,500¥ per Guardian, +1,500¥ per pod; backup power +5,000¥; rearming systems +10,000¥ each (one per three storage upgrades); weatherproofing +10,000¥. Not normally on the street.
